ASVspoof2019-LA-eval-sample10k.note: Stratified random 10,000-utterance sample of the ASVspoof2019 LA eval partition (of 71,933 total; 1,032 bonafide / 8,968 spoof, same ratio as the full partition), attack algorithms A07-A19 -- none of these were used in training (train used A01-A06). Evaluated against the current artifacts/model.pth self-trained checkpoint.
